title: Stickyz Rock N' Roll Chicken Shack
venue_description:
About Stickyz

Stickyz Rock N' Roll Chicken Shack is Little Rock's original gourmet chicken finger and live music venue located in the beautiful River Market District. Locally conceived owned and operated by Chris King and Suzon Awbrey since 1998 Stickyz has become an institution in the Little Rock music scene.

Live Music Programming

The venue features live music Tuesday through Saturday nights in their dedicated music room with a groovy sound stage. The musical programming is incredibly diverse ranging from rock and metal to blues jam bands funk and alternative. Stickyz has hosted nationally touring acts as well as the best local and regional talent. Notable performances have included jam band favorites like FreeVerse doom metal legends Pallbearer and countless touring rock and metal acts. The venue has a capacity suitable for intimate shows while maintaining professional sound quality.

Venue Features

The main music room provides an excellent listening environment with quality sound engineering. There is also a patio area for outdoor performances and dining. The venue books a wide variety of genres making it a versatile space for different musical styles. Past events have included metal shows rock concerts jam band performances and community rock jam sessions.

Food and Drink

Stickyz is famous for their hand-cut hand-rolled gourmet chicken fingers which can be prepared in numerous creative flavor combinations from classic original to jalapeno-ginger with Creole mustard. The menu also features burgers sandwiches salads and Southern specialties. The full bar serves craft beers and cocktails. Kitchen hours run late to accommodate music fans.

Atmosphere

The venue maintains a casual rock and roll vibe that appeals to music lovers of all ages. The decor embraces the rock and roll chicken shack theme with music memorabilia and a laid-back aesthetic. The staff is known for being friendly and the venue has built a loyal following over its more than 25 years in operation.
location: 107 River Market Ave Little Rock AR 72201

title: White Water Tavern
venue_description:
About White Water Tavern

Founded in 1976 the White Water Tavern is one of Little Rock's longest-running barrooms and music venues. This legendary establishment has been nationally recognized by Esquire The New York Times and scores of touring musicians as one of the best live music rooms and dive bars in the country.

Music Legacy

For nearly 50 years White Water Tavern has been a stop on the tour for musicians from across the country and around the world. The intimate wooden building features a small stage that has hosted everyone from Levon Helm and Billy Bragg to Leon Bridges and countless other notable artists. The venue books a wide variety of local and regional music and has hosted open jams karaoke and community events throughout its history. Recent performers have included Parker Millsap John Moreland Spirit Adrift and many acclaimed Americana roots rock blues and alternative artists.

Venue Character

The White Water Tavern epitomizes the classic American roadhouse and juke joint aesthetic. The intimate setting with a capacity of around 200 creates an up-close experience with performers. An upstairs area features pool tables and darts while a small patio in back has picnic tables. The venue is divey in all the good ways maintaining its authentic character while providing quality sound for performances.

Atmosphere and Services

The tavern operates a bar with 10 taps featuring a good selection of beer and liquor. A small kitchen serves a limited menu of pub food. Staff members are known for being incredible and welcoming. The venue is closed Mondays but otherwise maintains regular hours Tuesday through Sunday with live music typically starting around 8-9 PM on show nights. There is also a beer garden that becomes a popular gathering spot in warmer months.

Historical Significance

The tavern has been part of Little Rock's cultural fabric for decades. Bill Clinton could be seen hanging out during his Arkansas Attorney General days. The venue contains unique touches including beer bottles holding ashes of former owners and patrons a taxidermied beaver and an oil painting of a naked accordion-wielding matador. The space has hosted more than just music including book sales chicken-and-waffle brunches traveling opera and even memorable events like the legendary zombie wedding.

title: Vino's
venue_description:
About Vino's

Vino's is a beloved brewpub and music venue located in the heart of Little Rock. With a capacity of 300 people this funky establishment has been a cornerstone of the local music scene for years featuring handcrafted ales New York-style pizza and calzones alongside live music nights.

Live Music Programming

Vino's hosts concerts for a wide range of genres including rock metal punk indie and alternative music. The venue has a packed schedule with performances from both local Arkansas bands and touring national acts. Recent and upcoming shows have featured diverse artists from heavy metal bands like Mammoth Caravan to punk and hardcore acts. The venue has no known age restrictions making it accessible to all music fans.

Venue Atmosphere

As a brewpub Vino's combines quality craft beer with a casual comfortable atmosphere. The venue is known for its handcrafted ales brewed on-site. The menu features New York-style pizza and calzones that have earned praise from regulars. The cool atmosphere and great pizza paired with excellent live music make it a popular destination for both dining and entertainment.

Location and Access

Located at 923 W 7th Street in Little Rock Vino's is easily accessible from downtown. The venue has built a dedicated following over the years with fans appreciating both the quality of the music programming and the relaxed pub environment. Staff and service receive consistent praise from attendees.

title: Four Quarter Bar
venue_description:
About Four Quarter Bar

Four Quarter Bar is a late-night bar and music venue located in the heart of the Argenta Arts District of North Little Rock. This 100+ capacity venue has become a beloved destination for music lovers food enthusiasts and craft beer aficionados.

Music Programming

Four Quarter Bar hosts live music performances featuring a diverse range of genres including acoustic blues country funk hip hop jam jazz rock and more. Music typically kicks off around 10:00 PM on weekends. The venue books both local and touring acts with recent shows featuring artists like Eddie Spaghetti from Supersuckers Mama Said String Band Mammoth Caravan and many others. The intimate setting provides an excellent listening environment for all types of musical performances.

Food and Drink

The bar offers a large craft beer selection as well as a full bar for making great cocktails. The food menu features fantastic options sourced from in-house smoked pork that raises the bar on late-night grub. Vegetarians need not worry as there are plenty of items designed specifically for plant-based diets. The kitchen is open from 3:00 PM until 1:30 AM nightly with brunch served on Sundays from noon to 3:00 PM. Popular menu items include the 4Q Burger and various pork-based specialties.

Venue Atmosphere

Four Quarter Bar maintains a late-night bar vibe that appeals to music fans and night owls. The venue is located in the vibrant Argenta Arts District placing it at the center of North Little Rock's cultural scene. The space is known for its welcoming atmosphere friendly staff and commitment to quality in both food and entertainment. The venue has been a proud multi-year sponsor of events like the Hillberry Festival demonstrating deep roots in the regional music community.
location: 415 Main St North Little Rock AR 72114

title: Hibernia Irish Tavern
venue_description:
About Hibernia Irish Tavern

Hibernia Irish Tavern is an authentic wholly Irish-owned pub that brings the true spirit of Ireland to Little Rock. Owner Gerry has successfully brought the menu and atmosphere of Ireland to life creating a genuine Irish pub experience in West Little Rock.

Music Programming

Hibernia's stage is home to both contemporary local bands and traditional Irish music. The venue proudly hosts the Little Rock Folk Club every month bringing in notable folk and acoustic artists. Traditional Irish sessions take place every Sunday afternoon from 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM where musicians gather to play Celtic tunes in the traditional session format. These sessions welcome guest musicians and have been a fixture of the venue for years.

Special Events

At least once per month the venue hosts award-winning musicians or bands directly from Ireland. Past performers have included internationally acclaimed harpists button-box players guitarists and singers. Live entertainment takes the stage many nights per week featuring both local and regional talent. The venue also hosts a weekly comedy open mic on Tuesday nights at 8:00 PM called The Mic at Hibernia where standup comedians can perform in a supportive environment.

Dining Experience

The menu features authentic Irish cuisine with items earning high praise from guests. The fish and chips are widely considered among the best in Little Rock featuring light delicious batter and fresh-cut fries. Other popular dishes include bangers and mash chicken strips shepherd's pie and various Irish stews. The food is delectable with everything from freshly made soups to unique sandwich combinations to heartier entrees.

Beverage Selection

Hibernia offers a nice selection of Irish beers on tap including what many locals consider the best Guinness in Little Rock. The full bar serves a variety of beverages and the staff is known for ensuring drinks flow smoothly alongside the friendly laughter of patrons.

Atmosphere and Staff

The tavern provides a fun lively atmosphere that captures the essence of an authentic Irish pub. The staff is amazing friendly and chatty creating a welcoming environment. Guests like Sarah are frequently mentioned for their excellent service. The venue successfully balances its role as both a quality restaurant and an entertainment space making it suitable for dining casual drinks or enjoying live music and comedy.
location: 9700 N Rodney Parham Rd Suite K Little Rock AR 72227

title: The Hall
venue_description:
About The Hall

The Hall is Little Rock's newest large-capacity live music and events space located on historic West 9th Street. With a standing room capacity of 1300 people this versatile venue has quickly become a major player in the Little Rock concert scene.

Concert Programming

The Hall has a packed schedule featuring performances from nationally touring artists across multiple genres including rock country metal hip hop alternative and more. Recent and upcoming shows have featured artists like Melissa Etheridge Wyatt Flores Marcus King Band Blackberry Smoke Blues Traveler Yelawolf and many others. The venue books both emerging artists and established acts creating a diverse calendar of events.

Venue Features

The Hall features a versatile open floor design with a spacious mezzanine and private bar area. The venue is equipped with professional concert-style production ensuring world-class sound and lighting for performances. Backstage suites and an easily accessible loading area accommodate touring artists and their crews. The modern facility can comfortably accommodate parties from 50 to 1300 people making it suitable for both intimate shows and larger concerts.

Events and Uses

While primarily known for concerts The Hall also hosts special events including New Year's Eve celebrations with events like Blue Mondays NYE and Club 90s NYE Massive. The space is equally suited for receptions fundraisers corporate events video shoots trade shows and conferences. The venue's professional staff takes care of every detail while the top-shelf bar staff works quickly to ensure guests receive a high-quality experience.

Location

Conveniently located just 2 minutes from downtown Little Rock at 721 W 9th Street The Hall sits on historic West 9th Street. The location provides easy access for both local attendees and out-of-town visitors. The venue has quickly established itself as one of the premier concert destinations in Central Arkansas.

title: Trio's Restaurant
venue_description:
About Trio's Restaurant

Trio's Restaurant is widely regarded as Little Rock's best restaurant where you'll not only see absolutely everyone in town but also enjoy the most creative meals in the city. The establishment has earned a reputation for combining exceptional cuisine with memorable entertainment experiences.

Jazz Programming

Trio's is famous for its world-class Jazz Night events featuring bi-weekly Thursday jam sessions organized by Solfude Music Group. These sessions bring together some of the best musicians in the Little Rock area for true improvised jazz performances. The Pavilion Room transforms into an intimate jazz club where the quality of musicianship rivals anything found in major cities. Doors open at 6:30 PM with music beginning at 7:00 PM. The events feature one of the best music audiences in Little Rock creating an atmosphere that inspires musicians to their highest level of performance.

Dining Excellence

Trio's serves lunch Monday through Saturday and dinner Tuesday through Saturday. The menu changes frequently and seasonally showcasing creative dishes made with local produce. The restaurant is Green Restaurant Certified demonstrating commitment to sustainability. Popular menu items include beef empanadas Thai shrimp curry blackberry pork chop with goat cheese butter the Duke of Windsor sandwich Voodoo Pasta Alfredo chicken enchiladas and the famous Trio's Spicy Spinach Dip. Desserts such as chocolate mousse cake homemade key lime pie and raspberry cheesecake are customer favorites.

Atmosphere and Service

The restaurant offers a cozy welcoming atmosphere with attentive staff who make every visit feel special. Chef Shanna and the owners travel extensively to bring back new and exciting culinary creations. Staff members like Jenna are frequently praised for making dining experiences truly unforgettable. The restaurant features patio dining an onsite bar and maintains a family-friendly environment while offering an upscale dining experience.

Event Format

For Jazz Night events tickets are sold through Eventbrite by tables of 2 4 6 and 8 as well as individual bar seats. Guests may select their table when purchasing tickets. Food and beverages from Trio's full dinner menu and bar are available but not included in the table ticket price. The intimate setting and combination of exceptional food with live jazz creates a unique entertainment experience that has become a Little Rock institution.
location: 8201 Cantrell Rd Suite 100 Little Rock AR 72227
